question: The famous ‘Hinglaj Mata’ temple is situated in which of the following neighbouring countries of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pakistan.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Hinglaj Mata-

 
 
• Bhagwan Shiva's first wife Sati's Brahmrandhra fall in Hinglaj, so this place and Mata is known as Hinglaj.
 
• She is worshipped by **C**hngla Khanp Musalman/ Charan Musalman.
 
• She is also known as Changli Mai.
 
• Her original temple is situated in Baluchistan in Pakistan.
 
• In Rajathan her temples are:
 
 
• Koyaliya cave, Siwana, Barmer
 
• Fatehpur, Sikar
 
• Beedasar, Churu__
 
• Lodrawa, Jaisalmer
 
• Arai, Ajmer
 
 
 
• Hinglaj Mata' sal is situated between the Ghadseesar pond.
 
• She is the favorite goddess of Pushkarna samaj in Jaisalmer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Maudra, Jalore place is related to Ashapura Mata.
 
• Bhunas, Nagore place is related to Jamway Mata.
 
• Rewasa, Sikar place is related to Jeen Mata.
